flows.title: Install coyomap into a coding agent

steps.phrase: run `make install` in the cloned coyomap folder
create the folder-local Python environment and install the map tool into it
steps.note: installing the skill depends on this step, so one command covers both

steps.phrase: copy the skill pointer into every coding agent's skills folder, with this clone's path written into it
point the coding agent at the method's entry document inside this clone
give the person's coding agent a `/coyomap` command it can run

flows.title: Serve the maps on this machine

steps.phrase: run `coyomap serve` to put every mapped project on one page
hand the typed command, its port and its options to the tool
start the local map server on the requested port
read the project folders remembered from earlier sessions
steps.note: no disk scan; the served set is exactly the remembered list

steps.phrase: read each remembered folder's map for its title, goal and pinned commit
report how many projects are being served and the address to open
show the address the maps are served at, and how to stop the server
open the landing page in the person's browser
carry the landing page's request for the remembered projects
re-read the remembered folders, so a project mapped since startup appears without a restart
return one card per remembered project, saying which of their maps can be opened
list every mapped project on one page, each one openable or removable

edges.why: runs the local map server when the `serve` command is typed
reads the remembered project folders it serves
adds a folder the person opens, drops one they remove and saves a new order
keeps the remembered project folders in a file under the home folder, re-read before every change
runs the map server in its own process group and restarts it when the tool's Python changes
sends the coding agent to the method's entry document inside the clone it was installed from
